recommendation: Implement comprehensive medication management for diabetes patients
implementation_steps: Conduct comprehensive medication reviews to identify and resolve drug-related problems
Provide medication counseling and education on proper medication use
Support medication adherence through targeted interventions
Titrate or adjust diabetes medications under protocol
Monitor for adverse effects and reinforce self-management education
evidence_summary: Pharmacist-led medication management interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in glycemic control, medication adherence, and identification of drug therapy problems in patients with diabetes across multiple studies.
citation: Care Management for Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: The Roles of Nurses, Pharmacists, and Social Workers
